# The PPLUS read plane of MASK-RT-gf180mcu_fd_io-f02's POWER_RAIL_COR_1, reduced to its 45-degree
# boundary and path (layer 31/0) after an earlier structure rescaled the read units by 5. Each op is
# what Magic 8.3.694's CIFMakeManhattanPath and the polygon reader paint into the plane, in order:
#   tri x0 y0 x1 y1 dir side   DBNMPaintPlane of one triangle (dir 1 = TT_DIRECTION, side 1 = right),
#                              then DBMergeNMTiles over it grown by one
#   rect x0 y0 x1 y1           DBPaintPlane
# and `tiles N SHA` gives the plane Magic holds after the last op: N solid tiles, in DBSrPaintArea
# order, written one per line as "x0 y0 x1 y1 split dir right" (split 1 for a split tile, dir 1
# for TT_DIRECTION, right 1 for a split tile solid on its right), have the SHA-256 SHA.
# Captured with an instrumented native build of Magic (round 7, m5-r7-iort).
